integrity: A mathematical proof and reproducible self-review are supplied. Classical Chebyshev and Bernoulli-convolution ingredients are explicitly acknowledged. No independent audit, originality certification or external numerical validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact scalar same-client first-order SRKCD only: even stage count, fixed positive damping and full open stability interval, equal component curvature, fair two-offset component gradients. No general nonlinear, stage-resampled, odd-stage, or finite-precision conclusions.
title: A sharp damping threshold for stationary-support topology in stochastic Chebyshev descent
